review_candidates.title: ISO Manager
review_candidates.description: Position Summary Manages the company's Quality Management System (QMS) to build, maintain, and continuously improve ISO 9001 certification across manufacturing and service operations. Scope includes in-house manufacture of new MCC buckets and UL 508A panels, servicing/reconditioning of molded case circuit breakers (MCCBs), insulated case circuit breakers (ICCBs), 480V motor control centers and MCC buckets, and integration of these products into new and existing customer systems. Ensures all processes meet customer, industry, and certification requirements, including PEARL standards for reconditioned equipment and, where applicable, 10 CFR Part 21 requirements for components supplied to nuclear-licensed facilities. Key Responsibilities Modify, implement, and maintain the ISO 9001 Quality Management System from the ground up, including quality manual, procedures, work instructions, and forms covering new MCC bucket manufacturing, new panel manufacturing, and breaker/MCC repair-and-reconditioning operations. Plan and execute internal audit schedules; serve as primary liaison for external ISO 9001 certification body audits. Lead nonconformance investigations, root cause analysis, and CAPA closure across manufacturing, repair, and field integration functions. Manage document control systems, including procedures, work instructions, engineering drawings, bills of material, test records, and quality records retention. Monitor quality metrics: scrap rate, first-pass yield, customer complaints, supplier quality, in-process/final inspection failure rates on manufactured buckets, breaker test/inspection failure rates, and warranty/return rates on reconditioned equipment. Report to leadership. Train staff on QMS requirements across engineering, production, bucket fabrication and assembly, panel assembly, and breaker service/repair teams. Ensure supplier and incoming inspection processes for electrical components (breakers, contactors, terminal blocks, wire, enclosures) and raw materials/components used in bucket manufacturing align with certification standards. Support customer quality audits and RFQ/quality-agreement reviews. Maintain and manage the UL 508A Follow-Up Service Program, including UL label control, production/manufacturing procedures for new buckets and panels, and coordination with the UL field inspector during periodic audits. Ensure production and service processes align with NFPA 70 (National Electrical Code) and NFPA 79 (Electrical Standard for Industrial Machinery) requirements as applicable to panelboard, control panel, and MCC bucket builds. Interface with engineering to ensure manufactured bucket designs, panel designs, component selection, and short-circuit current ratings (SCCR) comply with UL 508A listing requirements. Establish and maintain quality procedures for manufacture of new MCC buckets and for the repair, reconditioning, and testing of MCCBs, ICCBs, 480V motor control centers, and existing MCC buckets, including incoming condition assessment, teardown inspection, refurbishment standards, and functional/dielectric test protocols. Align breaker and MCC reconditioning procedures with the ANSI/PEARL Electrical Equipment Reconditioning Standard (EERS) and Inspect & Test Standard (EEITS), issued by the Professional Electrical Apparatus Reconditioning League (PEARL). Align breaker and MCC reconditioning procedures with applicable NETA acceptance and maintenance testing standards. Maintain traceability and certification records distinguishing newly manufactured, reconditioned, and integrated components, including test reports and calibration records for test equipment. Ensure quality procedures address system integration work — verifying that newly manufactured buckets and repaired/reconditioned breakers and MCC buckets meet fit, function, and rating requirements before installation into new or existing customer systems, in compliance with NFPA 70 installation and labeling requirements. Oversee calibration program for test equipment used in bucket and breaker testing (contact resistance, insulation resistance, primary/secondary injection testing). Support and maintain PEARL membership requirements and associated EERS/EEITS standard compliance for the company's reconditioned equipment product line. Where components are supplied to NRC-licensed nuclear facilities or as commercial-grade dedicated items for nuclear safety-related applications, maintain a 10 CFR Part 21 program covering evaluation of deviations for substantial safety hazards, defect/noncompliance reporting to the NRC, procurement document flow-down, and required recordkeeping. Education Requirements Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Technology, Quality Management, or related technical field required. ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification required or must be obtained within 6 months of hire. ASQ certification (CQE, CQM/OE, or CMQ/OE) preferred. Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred. Experience Requirements Minimum 5–7 years in quality management within electrical equipment manufacturing and/or electrical apparatus service industry preferred. Demonstrated experience building and/or maintaining an ISO 9001 program from initial certification through recertification cycles. Direct experience in a UL 508A panelboard/control panel shop, including UL Follow-Up Service audits, panel labeling requirements, and component listing verification preferred. Experience with quality control in low-voltage switchgear/MCC bucket fabrication and assembly (sheet metal, bus work, wiring, component mounting) preferred. Experience with circuit breaker and/or motor control center repair, reconditioning, or remanufacturing operations preferred. Familiarity with PEARL EERS/EEITS reconditioning standards and NETA testing standards for low- and medium-voltage electrical equipment preferred. Working knowledge of NFPA 70 (NEC), NFPA 79, and UL 508A short-circuit current rating (SCCR) requirements preferred. Experience with 10 CFR Part 21 defect reporting and commercial-grade dedication programs preferred. Experience with documentation for newly manufactured and reconditioned/refurbished electrical equipment, including test reports and component traceability preferred.

Requisitos: • Profesional universitario en Administración de Empresas, Mercadeo, Ingeniería, Negocios, Tecnología o carreras afines. • 5 años o más de experiencia en posiciones comerciales, preferiblemente en empresas de tecnología, servicios TI, telecomunicaciones, ciberseguridad, infraestructura o soluciones empresariales. • Experiencia comprobada liderando equipos de ventas y desarrollando estrategias comerciales. • Experiencia en ventas B2B y venta consultiva de soluciones tecnológicas. • Conocimiento en elaboración y ejecución de planes comerciales, presupuestos y estrategias de crecimiento. • Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de negocio, desarrollar nuevos clientes y mantener relaciones comerciales de largo plazo. • Experiencia en manejo de CRM, pipeline de ventas, forecast y seguimiento de oportunidades. • Conocimiento de procesos de licitaciones, propuestas comerciales, cotizaciones y negociaciones con clientes corporativos. • Habilidades para negociar con clientes, proveedores y aliados estratégicos. • Orientación al cumplimiento de metas, indicadores comerciales y rentabilidad. • Capacidad de análisis de mercado, competencia y tendencias del sector tecnológico. • Excelentes habilidades de liderazgo, comunicación, negociación y toma de decisiones. • Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y gestionar múltiples oportunidades comerciales simultáneamente. • Inglés intermedio-avanzado • Disponibilidad para realizar visitas a clientes y participar en reuniones, eventos y actividades comerciales. 💡 Valoramos especialmente la experiencia en soluciones de ciberseguridad, cloud, infraestructura, networking, virtualización y servicios tecnológicos. Competencias clave Liderazgo | Orientación a resultados | Negociación | Visión estratégica | Comunicación efectiva | Pensamiento analítico | Orientación al cliente | Desarrollo de negocios | Liderazgo de equipos | Planificación y organización

review_candidates.title: General Manager (Industrial Product)
review_candidates.description: A stable family business with strong Merge and Acquisition activities Working direct with owners, so no corporate layers. About Our Client This role is within the industrial/manufacturing sector in Vietnam. Job Description As the General Manager, you will play a pivotal role in the leadership and management of the entire organization. Reporting directly to the Chairman of the company, you will be responsible for overseeing the Profit & Loss (P&L) for the business and ensuring the seamless coordination of various departments, including Sales, Marketing, Design, Costing, Production, Quality, Supply Chain, HR, Finance, and Safety. P&L Oversight: Manage and optimise the company's financial performance, ensuring profitability and sustainability. Departmental Leadership: Provide strategic guidance and leadership to departments such as Sales, Marketing, Design, Costing, Production, Quality, Supply Chain, HR, Finance, and Safety. Market Expansion: Drive initiatives to expand the company's presence in the European and American markets, identifying growth opportunities and ensuring effective market penetration. Quality Control: Oversee and enhance quality control processes to ensure the delivery of top-notch products that meet international standards. Supply Chain Management: Develop and implement efficient supply chain strategies to streamline production processes and meet customer demands. Team Management: Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting effective communication and teamwork across all levels of the organisation. Safety Compliance: Ensure the implementation of rigorous safety protocols and compliance with industry regulations to maintain a safe working environment. Human Resources: Work closely with the HR department to attract, develop, and retain top talent, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional development. The Successful Applicant Minimum of 10 years of experience in a P&L management role, preferably in a manufacturing setting. Technical background in civil or mechanical engineering, demonstrating a deep understanding of the steel structure manufacturing industry. Proven track record of successful leadership and people management. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Pro-active and hard-working attitude, with a commitment to achieving organisational goals. Ability to navigate and thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. What's on Offer A competitive salary Use of a company car. Performance-based bonus. This is a role to take on a leadership role in the industrial/manufacturing sector. If you are ready to make an impact, we encourage you to apply. Quote job ref: JN-092026-7110211

review_candidates.title: GP Operator Ordinary Seaman
review_candidates.description: Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond. About Us: SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy. Reports To GP Foreman Background The General Purpose (GP) Operator will exhibit a high standard of safety behavior and will ensure that all aspects of shipboard maintenance, rigging, slinging, painting and preservation, storage, housekeeping, and general duties are carried out safely and effectively. Authority The GP Operator has authority to carry out shipboard maintenance under the direction of the GP Foreman. The GP operator will ensure the safety of himself, team members, visitors and subcontractors within the limits of his responsibility. Immediate Subordinates Visitors, subcontractors Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards 1) Develop And Maintain Effective Working Relationships 1 Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and visitors to the working environment. 2 Establish and maintain effective communications with colleagues and supervisors. 3 Carry out accurate and effective work handovers. 2) Conduct Slinging and Rigging Operations 1 Check preparation of loads for lifting. (Load is secure and stable) 2 Use various lifting items (plate clamps, barrel lifters chain hoists etc.) 3 Perform bundling and slinging of simple and awkward loads 4 Maintain slinging equipment (slings, hooks, webbing plate clamps, barrel lifters chain hoists etc.) 3) Perform Effective Signaling/Communications 1 Direct the movement and placing of loads using appropriate hand and radio communication techniques 2 Rig, sling and position blind load using appropriate hand signals. 3 Rig, sling and position blind load using radio communications 4) Perform Preparation And Cleaning Of Equipment For Maintenance Or Coating 1 Prepare the site for abrasive blasting and clean surfaces using abrasive tools 2 Paint or coat the worksite using correct colors, paints or protective coatings. 3 Examine portable power and hand tools before and after use reporting any defects immediately 4 Restore the worksite after cleaning and coating 5) Contribute to The Health and Safety of the Working Environment 1 Work area within your own responsibility is kept clean and free of hazards. 2 Positive action is taken to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors 3 Alarms are raised as appropriate and/or acted upon using applied policies and procedures or initiative 4 All potential and actual incidents are reported to the relevant supervisor 5 Record maintenance activities and report defects immediately and effectively 6) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures 1 Controlled process or utility discharges from the area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits 2 Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to Management System guidelines. 3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are segregated properly and dealt with according to the correct procedure. 7) Emergency Response 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill). 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises. Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies Offshore - Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Offshore - Emergency Response Offshore - Slinging and Rigging Operations Offshore - Perform Fabric Maintenance Offshore - Safety Management Offshore - Confined space entries Offshore - Waste Management Offshore - Radio Procedure Pre-hire Qualifications And Experience Certification as per STCW Reg A II/5 or equivalent. Over 2 years’ experience in a deck capacity in the offshore or shipping industries. Rigging and Lifting Certified. Banksman Slinger Certified. Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore. GENERAL INFORMATION If you are interested and meet the requirements to perform this role, please apply via: Our website – www.sbmoffshore.com At this time, we are seeking candidates who are Guyanese and living in Guyana. We wish to thank all applicants for their interest. Please be guided that only selected candidates will be contacted. For more information on SBM Offshore, please visit www.sbmoffshore.com

review_candidates.title: Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Executive
review_candidates.description: About the Opportunity We are looking for an FP&A Executive to join its finance team. You will contribute to the company's planning, budgeting, and forecasting cycle, keep financial models up to date, track business performance, and turn numbers into clear, timely insights that help leadership make informed decisions. What You Will Do Forecasting & Financial Modelling Help build and update short- and long-range financial forecasts Develop and refine driver-based financial models using operational and business inputs Gather, organize, and analyze financial and operational data to support forecasts Contribute to scenario planning and sensitivity testing Track how accurate forecasts are, and report on emerging trends, risks, and opportunities Budget Management Coordinate the annual budget cycle and consolidate inputs from departments Maintain budgeting templates and guide departments through their submissions Produce budget-vs-actual variance reports Support monthly budget reviews and follow through on agreed actions Performance Reporting & Insights Prepare management reports and concise performance summaries Compare actual results against budget and forecast, and explain the gaps Monitor key performance indicators Contribute to dashboards and monthly reporting packs Carry out ad hoc financial analysis as business needs arise Cost Control & Profitability Keep track of departmental spending Flag opportunities to reduce costs and improve efficiency Support margin and profitability analysis What We Are Looking For Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline Professional qualification (preferred): ACCA, CA Inter, CMA, MBA Finance, or equivalent Experience: At least 2 years in FP&A, budgeting, financial reporting, or financial analysis, with 3–4 years preferred
